drive car2 myagang-temple kispang-shelter

drive car2 kispang-shelter myagang-temple
load car2 elderly 1
load car2 adult 3

</plan>
COST: 476

Notes:
- Tadi market and Naukunda farm have no open road to the evacuation point, so their people must be deferred.
- Dupcheshwar temple's only route is a 52-minute round trip, which costs more than the 50-minute deferral penalty for one elderly person, so it is deferred.
- Car 1 rescues the four children from Galchhi (82 driving minutes, versus 240 in penalties). Car 2 makes two trips to Myagang temple (64 minutes) to rescue all eight people there.
